owner_and_capability: Staff Offboarding workflow; Membership retirement, Workforce offboarding and leased document cleanup, Timetable offboarding, People unlink, Identity access revocation, Audit append
atomic_cutover: Replace the sole legacy repository-coordinating provider with workflows/staffoffboarding in production Membership deletion. Owner preview/execute share a tenant UnitOfWork; irreversible cleanup uses durable owner intents and after-commit worker wake-ups. No dual provider or direct workflow SQL remains.
tests: Owner and workflow drift, foreign-tenant/auth cases, history retention, concurrent planning and supervision, owner-command/audit/intent rollback, idempotency, leased file-cleanup failure/retry and expired-token fencing; production HTTP and backend ratchets.

runtime_evidence.workload: 2026-09-09 local isolated PostgreSQL 17.11 clone, Go 1.27.0 darwin/arm64; five warmups plus 30 sequential preview and execute calls with account, token, future shift, future timetable assignment and real durable enqueue. File failure/retry is a separate workload.
runtime_evidence.thresholds: No task-specific latency SLO or query budget is defined. Existing architecture/composition/query and behavior gates apply; measured values are observations, not fitted thresholds or a production performance claim.
runtime_evidence.query_count: Preview 29 statements, execute 103 statements. Execute reports 13 successful DML rows per sample; preview zero. Fixture setup is excluded.
runtime_evidence.errors: 0/30 errors per measured operation; zero database deadlocks and zero measured pool waits. Separate stale-preview and authorization cases reject without partial writes.
runtime_evidence.failure: Injected absence/final audit failures and cleanup-intent failure roll back. Actual file-removal failure leaves backlog one; retry after 60 seconds completes on attempt two and backlog becomes zero. Expired leases are reclaimable and old tokens cannot finish jobs.
runtime_evidence.rollback: Five workflow phase injections plus the real-composition post-Identity cleanup-intent failure preserve all affected owner state. Retrying succeeds and repeated retirement is a no-op.
runtime_evidence.smoke: Real owner composition, production staff-delete HTTP tests, kiosk/session tests, document upload/download/delete/recovery tests and expanded Workforce/Timetable/Active/Schedule/Users suites exercise the cutover. Full-backend and architecture gates are run before completion.

rollback_and_cleanup: Before commit, abort the shared UnitOfWork. After irreversible cleanup, do not resurrect credentials or files implicitly; use owner restoration/anonymization policy. Preserve history/audit. Remove obsolete legacy interfaces/adapters together with the old workflow provider.
exit_criterion: Preview and execution agree; each owner mutates its own data; cleanup is durable and leased; no direct workflow repository writes or dual provider remain. Architecture/composition baselines do not grow, existing ownership remains unchanged, and the new cleanup table belongs to Workforce.
